name: Exp_JSatlCandle
summary: This EA is a trend-following expert advisor based on the JSatl (JSA Trend Line) indicator combined with candlestick pattern analysis. It generates buy signals when the JSatl indicator confirms an uptrend and candlestick patterns support continued upward momentum, and sell signals under the opposite conditions. The EA automates trade entry, exit, and position management based on these combined technical signals.
summary_zh: 该EA是基于JSatl（JSA趋势线）指标与K线形态分析相结合的趋势跟踪智能交易系统。当JSatl指标确认上升趋势且K线形态支撑继续上涨时产生买入信号，反之则产生卖出信号。该EA基于这些组合技术信号自动执行入场、出场和仓位管理。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是利用JSatl趋势线指标判断主趋势方向，结合K线形态确认入场时机，实现趋势跟踪交易。入场条件为：JSatl指标显示趋势方向转变（如从下降转上升时做多），同时配合K线形态（如看涨吞没、锤子线等反转形态）进行二次确认。出场条件包括：JSatl指标发出反向信号、达到预设的止盈止损目标、或K线形态出现反转信号时平仓。仓位管理方面，EA支持固定手数交易，可能根据账户资金比例进行仓位调整。资金管理方面，通过止损设置控制单笔风险，但具体是否包含动态止损或追踪止损需参考参数配置。整体策略属于典型的技术指标组合型趋势跟踪系统，依赖指标信号的及时性和准确性。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of this EA is to use the JSatl trend line indicator to determine the main trend direction, combined with candlestick pattern confirmation for entry timing, implementing trend-following trading. Entry conditions are: the JSatl indicator shows a trend direction change (e.g., going long when shifting from downtrend to uptrend), confirmed by a secondary candlestick pattern signal (such as bullish engulfing, hammer, or other reversal patterns). Exit conditions include: the JSatl indicator issuing a reverse signal, reaching preset take-profit or stop-loss targets, or candlestick patterns showing reversal signals triggering position closure. Position sizing supports fixed lot trading and may adjust position size based on account equity percentage. Money management controls per-trade risk through stop-loss settings, though whether dynamic or trailing stops are included depends on parameter configuration. The overall strategy is a typical technical indicator combination trend-following system, relying on the timeliness and accuracy of indicator signals for profitability.

parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 means no take profit

parameters.name: CandlePattern
parameters.description: 是否启用K线形态确认过滤

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于标识本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for order identification

parameters.name: Timeframe
parameters.description: 指标计算时间框架，0为当前图表周期

pros: JSatl指标与K线形态双重确认机制，减少假信号入场概率
趋势跟踪逻辑清晰，在明确趋势行情中能获取较大波段利润
参数可配置性较好，允许交易者根据不同品种和市场环境调整策略参数
pros_en: Dual confirmation mechanism of JSatl indicator and candlestick patterns reduces the probability of entering on false signals
Clear trend-following logic capable of capturing large swing profits during well-defined trending markets
Good parameter configurability allows traders to adjust strategy parameters for different instruments and market conditions
cons: 趋势跟踪策略在震荡行情中容易产生频繁虚假信号导致连续亏损
止损默认值为0存在重大风险，可能导致单笔交易无限制亏损
缺乏明确的资金管理规则和最大回撤控制机制，长时间逆势可能造成严重损失
cons_en: Trend-following strategies are prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses during ranging or choppy markets
Default stop-loss value of 0 poses significant risk, potentially leading to unlimited loss on a single trade
Lacks explicit money management rules and maximum drawdown controls, prolonged adverse conditions could cause severe losses
improvements: 增加震荡行情过滤机制（如ADX指标或波动率过滤），减少盘整期的虚假信号交易
添加动态止损和追踪止损功能，实现盈利保护和风险控制自动化
improvements_en: Add ranging market filter mechanism (such as ADX indicator or volatility filter) to reduce false signal trades during consolidation periods
Implement dynamic stop-loss and trailing stop functionality for automated profit protection and risk control

risk_points: 默认止损为0，若未手动设置则单笔交易风险不可控
趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中可能产生连续亏损，缺乏震荡过滤保护
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss of 0 means single-trade risk is uncontrolled if not manually configured
Trend-following strategy may generate consecutive losses in ranging markets without consolidation filter protection
